title: CCreate
description: Extreme tech-pack managing to connect Veteran and Casual players.
body:
# CCreate
**CCreate** is a spiritual successor to **[BCreate](https://modrinth.com/modpack/bcreate)**, and it **bridges casual** and **veteran players** by making the night a **hellscape** if you don't find shelter.

This modpack HEAVILY punishes you if you fight mobs regularly and eventually pushes you into making a safe space as oposed to the ususal "starter base" that's just two chests, a crafting table and bed, while being really performant for how it looks.

## CORE of the mod

- **[Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) 6**! Frogs with addons: [New Enchanment Industry](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-enchantment-industry), [Power Loaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-power-loader), [Dreams & Desires](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-dreams-and-desires) and [Slice&Dice](https://modrinth.com/mod/slice-and-dice).

  - Basically Create addons: [CC: Tweaked](https://modrinth.com/mod/cc-tweaked) & [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) with many addons.

- **QOL**: [Corpse](https://modrinth.com/mod/corpse), [Hardcore Revival](https://modrinth.com/mod/hardcore-revival), Easy [Anvils](https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-anvils)/[Shulkers](https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-shulker-boxes), [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)[+](https://modrinth.com/mod/just-enough-resources-jer), [Cut Through](https://modrinth.com/mod/cut-through), [Dark Mode](https://modrinth.com/mod/dark-mode-everywhere) and [Xaero](https://modrinth.com/user/thexaero)'s stuff.

- **Casual** Friendly: [Pet Cementary](https://modrinth.com/mod/pet-cemetery), (new)[Tempad](https://modrinth.com/mod/tempad), [Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/travelersbackpack), [Artifacts](https://modrinth.com/mod/artifacts) and [Distant Friends](https://modrinth.com/mod/distant-friends) :D

- **Mob AI** changes: [AI Improvements](https://modrinth.com/mod/ai-improvements), [Improved Mobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/improved-mobs) and [Zombie Awareness](https://modrinth.com/mod/zombie-awareness).

  - ALSO adds **More Mobs** via: [Mutant Monsters](https://modrinth.com/mod/mutant-monsters), [Illager Invasion](https://modrinth.com/mod/illager-invasion) and [Friends&Foes](https://modrinth.com/mod/friends-and-foes-forge)

- **Performance**! [Embeddium](https://modrinth.com/mod/embeddium), [Noisium](https://modrinth.com/mod/noisium), [Immediately Fast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast), [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core), [ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix), [C2ME](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-neoforge) and much more.

- **Visual** Upgrades!! [Distant Horizonts](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons), [Explosive Enhancement](https://modrinth.com/mod/explosive-enhancement-forge), [Not Enough Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/not-enough-animations) and [Lithosphere](https://modrinth.com/datapack/lithosphere).

## Default Pack
The pack by default is setup to be **balanced for both casuals AND veteran** players, but can be tweaked to either make it easier or harder. There are many things fine tuned in the configs, 

You're ofcourse free to remove Mutants, AI changes, Revert "No Elytra" and stuff to make it easier, but if you want the game to be harder I can recommend doing self imposed challanges, like Hardcore mode, no sleeping or, what I'd recommend is opening configs/improvedmobs/common.toml and changing "Enable difficulty scaling" to "true".

That setting makes the game scale armor, health, damatge and weapons of mobs the longer you play. This is not on by default because you can't really pace something like that in an inclusive way so to speak.
